# Third-party source

`cgltf` is included as a pinned Git submodule for the generic `gltf2act`
converter only. It is not linked into the engine or runtime.

- project: <https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf>
- pinned commit: `85cd62382dfea638278962690cf515023f33ed00`
- licence: MIT; the complete notice is in `cgltf/LICENSE`

Clone this repository with `git clone --recurse-submodules`, or run
`git submodule update --init --recursive` before enabling tools.
